title: ‘Not an issue with VP’: Poa says nothing wrong with having Leni Robredo supporters in Duterte’s defense team
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte and her defense team sees no issue with several defense lawyers having different political affiliations, panel spokesperson Michael Poa said on Thursday.
